raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`test/srt/` is retired, but three test files were reintroduced there and are outside `run_suite.py` discovery.

## Modifications

- Move both AITER guard tests to `test/registered/attention/`, preserving their AMD registrations and test bodies.
- Move the Mamba2 checkpoint-remapping test to `test/registered/unit/models/`, register it for CPU CI, use `CustomTestCase`, and update its run command.
- Reject `test/srt/` paths in pre-commit. The existing lint workflow runs these hooks with `--all-files`, so CI also rejects a legacy path restored by a merge. Document the supported locations in `test/README.md`.

## Validation

All 15 existing test cases passed locally. The updated Mamba2 test also passes with CUDA hidden. Changed-file pre-commit checks and registry validation pass. The path guard was checked against both supported paths and a nested legacy path.

The first commit is a byte-identical relocation; the second contains registration, documentation, and guard changes. The full chain verifier reports PASS (1/1 move proof).

## Accuracy Tests

No inference implementation changes.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No serving performance changes.

## Checklist

- [x] Format code with pre-commit.
- [x] Preserve existing test coverage and validate registrations.
- [x] Update test-layout documentation.
- [x] Follow SGLang code style.

## Mechanical move — reproducible

[Proof scripts and verification report](https://gist.github.com/merrymercy/be31365698592becea17f6880900c3c6) generated with the [mechanical-refactor-verify skill](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.agents/skills/mechanical-refactor-verify/SKILL.md).

Download the proof and run it from the SGLang repository root:

```bash
gh gist clone be31365698592becea17f6880900c3c6 /tmp/sglang-retire-srt-proof
python3 /tmp/sglang-retire-srt-proof/2221896886bb478b0c660c3e34e7437090e17be0.py
```

The proof checks the intermediate move commit. The following commit adds Mamba2's registration and the directory guards; final-head registry and pre-commit validation passed separately.
